rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; Triage (rerun after BUG-0913/-02): 186/256 agree; 9 candidate-unknown, 5 project-refuses, 55 project-unknown, 1 value. The value differences are fixtures k1s.material_by_earlier_years and classm.k1s.8 (box 1 $12,000, no work in 2025, k1s.past_years Yes): the reply counts test 5/6 only when the shareholder also worked in 2025 (it ANDs k1s.work with the tests), so it puts the $12,000 in passive column (h) instead of nonpassive column (k). i1120ssk p. 4, test 5: "You materially participated in the activity for any 5 tax years (whether or not consecutive) during the 10 tax years that immediately precede the tax year"; no participation in the current year is required. The project is right; the rest are project-refuses/unknown on records the project refuses or never builds.
